description: A Severance 400 bolted to the wall. Bounties on the amber screen, name and price. Coin slot to post one. The round stainless port down at floor level takes a head and counts out what it's worth. PAYABLE ON DELIVERY. This one's been hit: cracked screen, scoured port, a gasket of inner tube.

receptacle.accept: The port takes it, inner tube squeaking as the outer door shuts. Something behind it turns over twice and stops.
receptacle.dark: The port won't cycle. No power in the wall behind it, and the cracked screen is blank.
receptacle.darkPost: Printer cold, screen dead. Nothing goes up on this terminal tonight.
receptacle.empty: A contract pays on delivery, and the port won't cycle for an empty hand.
receptacle.room: {handle} crouches at the terminal and puts something in the port. It counts out {amount}, and the two people who looked up go back to their drinks.

name: bounty terminal
